name: Should I choose a pedestal sink or a wall-mounted sink for knee clearance?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a pedestal sink or a wall-mounted sink for knee clearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both pedestal and wall-mounted sinks can provide knee clearance, but wall-mounted sinks generally offer more flexibility and often superior clearance. Pedestal sinks, while open underneath, often have a central pedestal that can still obstruct wheelchair approach if not carefully chosen. Wall-mounted sinks leave the floor completely clear, allowing for maximum maneuverability. When selecting, consider the specific model's dimensions, the height of the basin, and whether any exposed plumbing beneath it will meet clearance requirements. Wall-mounted sinks are typically preferred for optimal accessibility.
